name: W4v4 - Form intake (person, lead / accountant / client)

assignments.name: phone_core
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = String(($('Form body').first().json.body['tel-660'] ?? $('Form body').first().json.body['your-phone'] ?? $('Form body').first().json.body.phone) ?? '').replace(/\D/g, ''); return d.length >= 9 ? d.slice(-9) : ''; })() }}

assignments.name: q_phone
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = String(($('Form body').first().json.body['tel-660'] ?? $('Form body').first().json.body['your-phone'] ?? $('Form body').first().json.body.phone) ?? '').replace(/\D/g, ''); return d.length >= 9 ? d.slice(-9) : ''; })() || 'no-phone-none' }}

assignments.name: attribution
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const b = $('Form body').first().json.body; return Object.fromEntries(["utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_term", "utm_content", "utm_id", "utm_source_platform", "gbraid", "wbraid", "referrer", "landing_page", "device"].map(k => [k, String(b[k] ?? '').trim().slice(0, ['referrer', 'landing_page'].includes(k) ? 2000 : 255)])); })() }}

assignments.name: person
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const core = $('Form data').first().json.phone_core; const e = $('Find person by email').all().map(i => i.json).find(r => r.Id); const p = $('Find person by phone').all().map(i => i.json).find(r => r.Id && core && String(r.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '').endsWith(core)); return e || p || {}; })() }}

assignments.name: activity_summary

assignments.name: activity_payload
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ email: $('Form data').first().json.email, phone: $('Form data').first().json.phone_raw, notes: $('Form data').first().json.notes, outcome: $('Intake outcome').first().json.outcome, attribution: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries($('Form data').first().json.attribution).filter(([k, v]) => v)) }) }}
